Hi Vivek / Marissa,

We reviewed the submitted commercial invoice and BOL for BOL 659172. One item to flag: the consignee EORI number on crate C is missing (likely a printing omission on the packing slip). We can clear the shipment but will require either:

A) An amended commercial invoice / packing list with the EORI included (preferred), or
B) A signed letter of authorization from Redwood accepting temporary clearance and agreeing to furnish corrected paperwork within 48 hours.

If you choose B, there will be an administration fee (estimate £85) and Customs may perform a physical spot-check. If you prefer A, please have the sender or ClientCo reissue the corrected invoice — if ClientCo needs us to advise on specific EORI formatting we can help.

Please advise so we can avoid a hold at customs.

Thanks,
Sana Malik
